> [!summary] Data available

## Foods & dishes
- [[BLEnD]]: Malay_Singapore (485 answer clusters), Mandarin_Singapore (437), Tamil_Singapore (375); 105 food questions each.
- [[WorldCuisines]] 58 dishes (0 Singapore-only); [[FmLAMA]] 9; [[World Wide Dishes]] 4. No recipes.

## Ingredients & food composition
No Singapore FCT processed or in the Backlog; [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (priority 2) is the nearest.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[Exposome-Explorer]] 36 rows (11 colorectal-cancer rows, Singapore Chinese Health Study); [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 23 records; [[NPASS]] 6 pairs; no CMAUP entry; [[KNApSAcK Family]] flag page not scraped. TCM via [[China]] sources. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No recipes or composition data for hawker dishes; no Singapore-specific plant data.
